old_findings.note: The four CREATE3 proxy calls are no longer named 'atInversebrah(...)': 'call create2.new_address with:'. But their args are now raw memory (regression 1).
The branch-free max and the selector or-chains with phi copies are unchanged in every onlyAuthorized function.

setTargetFunctionRole's body now appears once (no peeled first iteration), and s is used: 'while True: ... if t + 1 >= cd[_param2 + 4]: stop'. The bound test is still mid-body, not 'while t < n'. deployMarket's raw calldata arithmetic is unchanged.

regressions.old: call create2.new_address.atInversebrah(int248 a, ...) with: args Bytes(640, 0x5261..), address(cd[_param1 + 132]), 64, mem[_80 + 800 len _84 + 32], Bytes(..)
regressions.issue: With the false selector gone, the decoder falls back to a raw memory range (P2: 1 -> 5 lines). The proxy's creation code (stored just before as 'Bytes(644, 0x6080..)') and the constructor arguments (implementation, initData) are no longer visible in the call.
regressions.rule: When the call data is a constant blob (not a 4-byte selector store) followed by ABI words, print it without a selector: 'args Bytes(644, 0x6080..), address(impl), 64, len, data'.

improvements: P1 is gone (16 lines: the Initializable slot 0xf0c57e16..00) and P6 is gone (31 lines). getRoleConfig (unknown629777a2) halved (205 -> 107 lines): dead stores of the role-name strings are dropped, and every role id reads 'uint64(sha3(Array(len=19, data='ROYCO_DEPLOYER_ROLE')))' instead of 'sha3(mem[_N + 32 len mem[_N]])', in initialize and deployMarket too. Storage writes and RoleGranted/RoleAdminChanged data are resolved from memory ('uint48(block.timestamp)', 'uint32(cd[..])'). multicall's delegatecall length is the computed sum.
notes: Diff 1953 lines; getRoleConfig moved, so its old and new bodies were diffed directly. initialize/deployMarket were reviewed by grouping changed forms: allocation checks re-expressed from mem[64], role constants named, CREATE3 calls, component checks ('static call mem[_78 + 76 len 20].authority()' instead of a one-use temp). No control-flow, storage or event change beyond decoding. The 26 '_N = call.func_hash == HEX' changes are whole-byte hex only.
summary: Improved: role constants are named, getRoleConfig halved, P1/P6 gone, the CREATE3 misname removed, and setTargetFunctionRole is no longer peeled. Regression: the four CREATE3 deployment calls lost their decoded code and constructor args (raw memory, P2 +4).
